user.title: Set up Ceska Posta
user.description: Ceska Posta tracking needs no account or postal code — the hub is created right away. Add parcels afterwards via the integration options or the `ceska_posta.track_parcel` service.

abort.already_configured: Ceska Posta is already set up.

data_description.add: Enter a 13-character Ceska Posta or Balikovna tracking code to start tracking it. You find it on the shipping confirmation e-mail or the missed-delivery card.

data_description.delivered_filter_type: Show delivered parcels from the last X days, or limit to the X most recent.
data_description.delivered_filter_amount: Number of days or parcels to show.

data_description.include_history: Add a per-parcel history attribute listing each status update (timestamp, status, original text). Off by default.

error.invalid_tracking_code: That does not look like a Ceska Posta tracking code.
error.already_tracked: That parcel is already being tracked.
error.unknown_tracking_code: Ceska Posta and Balikovna have no record of that tracking code.

track_parcel.name: Track parcel
track_parcel.description: Start tracking a parcel by its Ceska Posta tracking code.

untrack_parcel.name: Untrack parcel
untrack_parcel.description: Stop tracking a parcel by its Ceska Posta tracking code.

tracking_code.name: Tracking code
tracking_code.description: The Ceska Posta tracking code to stop tracking.

trigger_type.parcel_delivery_time_changed: A parcel's expected delivery time changed
